paper_title: Langfristige Wohnstandortpräferenzen: Schlechte Nachrichten für ländliche Regionen
caption: Haushalte in Westdeutschland
model_annotation: The diagram illustrates the distribution of households in West Germany across various regional categories and housing types from 1984 to 2020. The x-axis represents the years, spanning from 1984 to 2020 in 5-year intervals, while the y-axis denotes the percentage, ranging from 0% to 35% in 5% increments. The diagram features six distinct lines, each representing a different category: "Städtische Regionen, Ein- und Zweifamilienhäuser" (blue line with asterisks), "Städtische Regionen, Mehrfamilienhäuser in Wohngebieten, überwiegend Neubauestand" (blue line with circles), "Städtische Regionen, Mehrfamilienhäuser in Wohngebieten, überwiegend Altbaubestand" (blue line with triangles), "Städtische Regionen, Mehrfamilienhäuser in zentralen Lagen" (blue line with squares), "Ländliche Regionen, Ein- und Zweifamilienhäuser" (green dotted line), and "Ländliche Regionen, Mehrfamilienhäuser" (green line). The blue line with asterisks starts at around 27% in 1984 and remains relatively stable, ending at approximately 26% in 2020. The blue line with circles begins at about 16% in 1984, decreases gradually to around 8% in 2010, and then stabilizes. The blue line with triangles starts at roughly 10% in 1984, increases to about 20% in 2015, and then levels off. The blue line with squares begins at approximately 23% in 1984, decreases slightly to around 21% in 2000, and then remains relatively stable. The green dotted line starts at about 9% in 1984 and increases gradually to around 12% in 2015 before decreasing slightly. The green line representing "Ländliche Regionen, Mehrfamilienhäuser" is not visible as it is likely overlapping with the green dotted line.
